dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to the Ohuitia Travel Agency! Feel free to check out our latest scenic spot photography services!

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Gaze upon the majestic Colorfall Cliffs and take pictures with the Airborne Asha! A summer sure to warm your soul!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hopefully, this time, there won't be any weirdoes showing up?

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Oh, don't be like that! That was all part of the competition, please don't get the wrong end of the stick. I promise you'll feel right at home this time, don't worry!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You sure changed your attitude quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's how one becomes a sales champion around here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I suppose I can give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Please wait right here, we'll start shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Ohuitia
dialogues.text: Of course, of course! I look forward to your next visit.
